en.hubeali: Ibn Mahboub, from Abu Walad who said,

‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about a man who was sick, acknowledged during the death to an inheritor, of there being a debt for him, over himself. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘That is allowed’. I said, ‘So if he were to bequeath to the inheritor with something?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Allowed’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ibn Mahbub has narrated from abu Wallad who has narrated the following: “I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam,

about the case of a man who in his illness at the time of his death confirms his owing a certain amount of debts to one of his heirs. He (the Imam) said, ‘It is permissible.’ I asked about his confirming his owing ‘something’ to one of his heirs. He (the Imam) said, ‘It is permissible.’”
